name: StormBurger
facts: Locations: Inglewood (1500 N La Brea Ave, Inglewood, CA 90302) and Long Beach (5801 Cherry Ave, Long Beach, CA 90805). Compton (336 W Alondra Blvd) is coming soon.
Inglewood hours: Sun-Thu 10:30 AM-12 AM, Fri-Sat 10:30 AM-1 AM.
Long Beach hours: Mon-Wed 10:30 AM-10 PM, Thu-Sun 10:30 AM-11 PM.
No phone number is shown in the app.
You earn 20 reward points per $1 spent.
Rewards: 1,000 pts Free fries, 1,800 pts Free shake, 3,000 pts Free Classic StormBurger, 4,500 pts Free combo.
Bonus points: 50 for a daily visit check-in, 100 for your first order, 200 on your birthday, 250 for in-app feedback.
Storm Run is a 45-second driving game with 3 lives. It is free to play for members.
Game prizes depend on score: 400 sauce, 600 fries or onion rings, 800 milkshake, 1,000 Free Classic StormBurger.
Weekly top score (Monday through Sunday close) wins a Free Double Classic StormBurger Combo. The board resets every Monday.
Game prizes must be used within 3 days, and you can hold one prize at a time.
The Free Daily Spin is allowed once per member per day and is always free.
Food prizes and discounts are good for 3 days at Inglewood or Long Beach, one reward per visit, and can't be combined.
One free account per person and per phone. You must be 13 or older. Under 18 needs a parent's or guardian's permission.
Combos come with fries and a soft drink. Upgrade to onion rings or a milkshake for +$2.00 each.
Sauces are homemade and $1.00 each.
You can build your own smash burger or chicken sandwich in the app.
Your info is used only for your rewards account and is never sold.
The app has a language menu with 12 languages.
Follow StormBurger on Instagram at @stormburger.
suggested: How do I play Storm Run?
How do I win the weekly prize?

qa.q: What are your hours?
qa.a: Inglewood: Sun-Thu 10:30 AM-12 AM, Fri-Sat 10:30 AM-1 AM. Long Beach: Mon-Wed 10:30 AM-10 PM, Thu-Sun 10:30 AM-11 PM.

qa.q: What time do you open?
qa.a: Both locations open at 10:30 AM every day.

qa.q: What time do you close in Inglewood?
qa.a: Inglewood closes at 12 AM Sunday through Thursday, and 1 AM Friday and Saturday.

qa.q: What time do you close in Long Beach?
qa.a: Long Beach closes at 10 PM Monday through Wednesday, and 11 PM Thursday through Sunday.

qa.q: Are you open late?
qa.a: Inglewood is open until 12 AM Sun-Thu and 1 AM Fri-Sat. Long Beach is open until 10 PM Mon-Wed and 11 PM Thu-Sun.

qa.q: Are you open on weekends?
qa.a: Yes. Inglewood is open Friday and Saturday until 1 AM, and Sunday until 12 AM. Long Beach is open Saturday and Sunday until 11 PM.

qa.q: Where are you located?
qa.a: Inglewood: 1500 N La Brea Ave, Inglewood, CA 90302. Long Beach: 5801 Cherry Ave, Long Beach, CA 90805. Compton is coming soon.

qa.q: What is the Inglewood address?
qa.a: 1500 N La Brea Ave, Inglewood, CA 90302.

qa.q: What is the Long Beach address?
qa.a: 5801 Cherry Ave, Long Beach, CA 90805.

qa.q: Is there a Compton location?
qa.a: Compton is coming soon at 336 W Alondra Blvd, Compton, CA 90220. It isn't open yet.

qa.q: How do I get directions?
qa.a: Tap the Directions button under your location in the app to open directions.

qa.q: Is there parking?
qa.a: I don't have parking details. Please ask staff at the location.

qa.q: What is your phone number?
qa.a: I don't have a phone number for StormBurger in the app. You can ask staff at the counter.

qa.q: Do you have happy hour?
qa.a: I don't have happy hour details. Please ask staff.

qa.q: Do you have daily specials?
qa.a: I don't have daily specials listed. The app does show holiday specials, so check the Specials card. Staff can tell you about today's deals.

qa.q: What holiday specials do you have?
qa.a: The app shows seasonal specials: Thunder Night Combo (Oct 20-31), Gobble Burger (Nov 20-28), Holiday Shake Stack (Dec 15-25), New Year BBQ Combo (Dec 29-Jan 1), Burgers for Two (Feb 7-14), Lucky Strips Combo (Mar 14-17), Cinco Spicy Combo (May 1-5) and Fourth of July Classic (Jul 1-4).

qa.q: What is the Thunder Night Combo?
qa.a: It's a Jalapeño Lightning Burger Combo with Thunder sauce on the side, running Oct 20-31. The app shows the code BOO for it.

qa.q: What is the Gobble Burger?
qa.a: It's the Thanksgiving-week special: a Turkey Burger plus onion rings, running Nov 20-28.

qa.q: What is the Holiday Shake Stack?
qa.a: A Double Classic StormBurger with a Mix Shake (vanilla and chocolate), running Dec 15-25.

qa.q: What is Burgers for Two?
qa.a: Two Classic StormBurgers and one Chocolate Shake with two straws, running Feb 7-14.

qa.q: Are the specials final?
qa.a: The specials shown in the app are samples. Ask staff to confirm what's running before you order.

qa.q: How do I join the rewards program?
qa.a: Join StormBurger Rewards in the app with your name, phone number and email. It's free.

qa.q: Does it cost anything to join?
qa.a: No. Membership is free, and no purchase is needed to join or to play.

qa.q: Is there a welcome offer?
qa.a: Yes. The app offers free fries with your next burger when you join.

qa.q: Who can join?
qa.a: Anyone in the US who is 13 or older. If you're under 18 you need a parent's or guardian's permission. It's one free account per person and per phone.

qa.q: Can I have more than one account?
qa.a: No. It's one free member account per person and per phone.

qa.q: Do I have to join to play the game?
qa.a: Storm Run is free to play for members. You can save a prize you win by joining StormBurger Rewards.

qa.q: How many points do I earn per dollar?
qa.a: You earn 20 points for every $1 you spend.

qa.q: How do I earn points?
qa.a: Show your member QR or code to the cashier when you pay (20 pts per $1). You can also get bonus points for check-ins, your first order, your birthday, feedback, referrals and the Daily Spin.

qa.q: How do I use my points at the register?
qa.a: Show your member QR or code to the cashier when you order, and your purchase adds points to your account.

qa.q: Do I get points for visiting?
qa.a: Yes. You get 50 bonus points once a day when staff scan your member QR or code.

qa.q: Is there a first-order bonus?
qa.a: Yes. Your very first order earns 100 bonus points.

qa.q: Do I get points for giving feedback?
qa.a: Yes. Honest in-app feedback earns 250 points, once per member, whatever your rating.

qa.q: Do I get points for a Google review?
qa.a: No. The app doesn't give points or prizes for Google reviews. There is a button to write one if you want to.

qa.q: Can I earn points by playing the game?
qa.a: Game prizes come from your score, and your best run can win food. The Daily Spin can also give you points.

qa.q: What rewards can I get with points?
qa.a: 1,000 pts = Free fries. 1,800 pts = Free shake. 3,000 pts = Free Classic StormBurger. 4,500 pts = Free combo.

qa.q: How many points for free fries?
qa.a: 1,000 points. At 20 points per $1, that's $50 spent.

qa.q: How many points for a free shake?
qa.a: 1,800 points.

qa.q: How many points for a free Classic StormBurger?
qa.a: 3,000 points.

qa.q: How many points for a free combo?
qa.a: 4,500 points.

qa.q: How do I redeem a reward?
qa.a: Open your rewards in the app and show it to the cashier. Staff may ask for the code on your phone and a matching account.

qa.q: Do my points expire?
qa.a: I don't have details on point expiration. Please ask staff. Points have no cash value.

qa.q: Are there levels or tiers?
qa.a: Yes. The app has member levels based on how many visits you make in a month, and higher levels can earn bonus points. Check your rewards card to see your level.

qa.q: Is there a birthday reward?
qa.a: Yes. You get 200 bonus points on your birthday when you add it to your account.

qa.q: How does the referral program work?
qa.a: Share your code with a friend. You earn 150 points when they join, and they get free fries. You earn more points as they order.

qa.q: Is there a bonus for being nearby?
qa.a: If you allow location, the app can alert you when you're within about 2 miles of a StormBurger. It also shows an offer for double stars on that day's order when you show it at the counter.

qa.q: How do I get double stars?
qa.a: Show the nearby offer in the app at the counter for double stars on today's order. Ask staff if you're unsure it applies.

qa.q: What is Storm Run?
qa.a: Storm Run is our 45-second driving game. Grab coins and StormBurger food, and dodge lightning, flying cows and stop signs to win prizes.

qa.q: How do I play Storm Run?
qa.a: Tap the left or right side of the road to change lanes. Grab coins and food, and avoid hazards for 45 seconds.

qa.q: What are the game controls?
qa.a: Tap the left or right side of the road, use the ◀ ▶ buttons under the game, or use the arrow keys on a computer.

qa.q: How does scoring work in Storm Run?
qa.a: Coins give +10. Classic StormBurger gives +60, Spicy Chicken +50, a Shake +40 and Fries +30. Hitting a flying cow, stop sign or lightning gives -100 and costs a life.

qa.q: How many lives do I get?
qa.a: You get 3 lives. Each hit costs a life, and after 3 hits the truck is totaled and your run ends.

qa.q: How long is a game?
qa.a: One run lasts 45 seconds, unless you lose all 3 lives first.

qa.q: What does the glowing lane mean?
qa.a: A glowing lane is about to be hit by lightning. Switch lanes quickly.

qa.q: What should I dodge in the game?
qa.a: Dodge lightning strikes, flying cows and stop signs. Each one costs a life and 100 points.

qa.q: How often can I play?
qa.a: Storm Run is free for members to play as often as you like.

qa.q: What prizes can I win in Storm Run?
qa.a: One run over 400 wins a free house sauce, 600 wins free fries or onion rings, 800 wins a free milkshake, and 1,000 wins a free Classic StormBurger.

qa.q: What is the weekly prize?
qa.a: The top score from Monday through Sunday close wins a Free Double Classic StormBurger Combo.

qa.q: When does the weekly leaderboard reset?
qa.a: The board resets every Monday.

qa.q: What happens if there is a tie?
qa.a: Ties go to the score that was posted first.

qa.q: When are weekly prizes picked?
qa.a: The top score at Sunday close wins. I don't have an exact winner announcement time, so ask staff.

qa.q: Are the game prizes real?
qa.a: The prizes shown in the app are samples. StormBurger picks the real ones, so ask staff to confirm current prizes.

qa.q: How do I claim a game prize?
qa.a: Save the prize to your StormBurger Rewards to get your code, then show it at StormBurger to redeem.

qa.q: How long do I have to use a game prize?
qa.a: A game prize must be used within 3 days.

qa.q: Can I win more than one prize at once?
qa.a: No. You can hold one prize at a time. Use it first, then your next win can be saved.

qa.q: Where is my best score saved?
qa.a: Your best score is saved on the phone you play on.

qa.q: Can I cheat or use bots?
qa.a: No. Scores made with cheats, scripts, bots or multiple accounts are disqualified.

qa.q: Is the game a game of skill?
qa.a: Yes. Your score depends on how well you play, and prizes are based only on your score, not chance.

qa.q: Do I need to buy something to play?
qa.a: No. No purchase is needed to play, spin or win, and buying doesn't improve your chances.

qa.q: What is the Daily Spin?
qa.a: It's a free wheel spin once a day for members. Every slice wins something: points, a discount or free food.

qa.q: How often can I spin?
qa.a: One spin per member per day, by Los Angeles time. Spins are always free.

qa.q: What can I win on the Daily Spin?
qa.a: You can win +100, +150 or +200 reward points, a free house sauce, $2 off any burger, free fries, or 10% off your order.

qa.q: What are the odds on the Daily Spin?
qa.a: +100 points 30%, +200 points 20%, +150 points 15%, free house sauce 15%, $2 off a burger 8%, free fries 7%, 10% off your order 5%.

qa.q: How long do spin prizes last?
qa.a: Food prizes and discounts are good for 3 days at Inglewood or Long Beach. It's one reward per visit and they can't be combined with other rewards.

qa.q: Is there a hidden bonus in the game?
qa.a: Yes. A roadside billboard rolls by once a run, and driving through its golden ▶ token gives a bonus of 500 points.

qa.q: What is the halftime break in the game?
qa.a: After about 90 seconds of total play, the next new run opens with a short break showing Antidote The Foodie's review of StormBurger. You can skip it or go back to the game.

qa.q: Can I order from the app?
qa.a: Yes. Tap Order Inglewood or Order Long Beach at the top of the app.

qa.q: Can I order from my table with a QR code?
qa.a: I don't have details on table ordering. Please ask staff how ordering works at your location.

qa.q: How do I pay?
qa.a: I don't have payment details. Please ask staff.

qa.q: Can I build my own burger?
qa.a: Yes. The app has a Build your burger tool. You can choose a smash burger or a chicken sandwich, add toppings, and place your order.

qa.q: What toppings can I add to a smash burger?
qa.a: Patties are $2.50 each, up to 3. American or Swiss cheese is $0.75 each, bacon $2.00, jalapeños $1.00. Onion straws, lettuce, tomato, onion and pickles are free. The base (brioche bun and Storm sauce) is $2.74.

qa.q: What can I add to the chicken sandwich?
qa.a: The base (brioche bun and mayo) is $2.00. A crispy or spicy (Thunder) fillet is $4.99. Add-ons: Swiss $0.50, kale slaw $0.50, American $0.75, bacon $2.00, jalapeños $1.00. Tomato and pickles are free.

qa.q: What combos do you have?
qa.a: Classic StormBurger Combo $11.99, Jalapeño Lightning Burger Combo $13.99, Kids Combo $11.99, and Chicken Sandwich Combo $12.99. All come with fries and a soft drink.

qa.q: What comes with a combo?
qa.a: Every combo comes with fries and a soft drink. You can upgrade fries to onion rings for +$2.00 and the drink to a milkshake for +$2.00.

qa.q: What burgers are on the menu?
qa.a: Jalapeño Lightning Burger $6.99, Turkey Burger $6.99, Kids Burger $5.99, and the Classic StormBurger. You can also build your own.

qa.q: What is in the Jalapeño Lightning Burger?
qa.a: Homemade avocado crema, Storm sauce, a 4oz patty, Swiss cheese, grilled onions and jalapeños. It's $6.99.

qa.q: What is in the Turkey Burger?
qa.a: Two 2oz turkey patties, lettuce, tomato, cheese, onions, pickles and burger sauce. It's $6.99.

qa.q: What do you have for kids?
qa.a: The Kids Burger ($5.99) has a 4oz patty and American cheese. The Kids Combo ($11.99) adds fries and a soft drink.

qa.q: Do you have a chicken sandwich?
qa.a: Yes. The Chicken Sandwich Combo is $12.99 with fries and a soft drink. You can also build one with a crispy or spicy Thunder fillet.

qa.q: What shakes do you have?
qa.a: The Mix Shake is $4.99 ('Why not both?'). Milkshakes come in vanilla, chocolate or mix.

qa.q: What sauces do you have?
qa.a: Our sauces are homemade and $1.00 each: Storm, BBQ, Honey Mustard and Spicy Mayo. Thunder, Ranch and Avocado Crema also appear in the app.

qa.q: Can I see the menu in 3D?
qa.a: Yes. Tap the 3D badge on a menu photo to see the dish up close, and burgers show how they're built.

qa.q: Are the menu photos real?
qa.a: The food photos in the app are AI-generated previews of the real menu items.

qa.q: Do you have vegetarian options?
qa.a: I don't have vegetarian details. Please ask staff.

qa.q: What about allergies?
qa.a: I don't have allergy information. Please tell staff about any allergies when you order.

qa.q: Can I change the language?
qa.a: Yes. Tap the 🌐 button at the top right to pick a language. Choices are English, Español, 简体中文, 繁體中文, 한국어, Tagalog, Tiếng Việt, Հայերեն, فارسی, 日本語, ไทย and Русский.

qa.q: Is there a kid mode for the game?
qa.a: There isn't a kid mode in the app. Players under 18 need a parent's or guardian's permission, and you must be 13 or older to play.

qa.q: How do I add the app to my phone?
qa.a: Use 📲 Add to Home Screen in the app. On iPhone, tap Share, then Add to Home Screen. On Android, use the Install button or the browser menu.

qa.q: Is there a wallet card?
qa.a: I don't have a wallet card in the app. You can add the app to your Home Screen for one-tap access to your rewards.

qa.q: What if I can't hear the game or want to turn off sound?
qa.a: Use the Settings on the game's start menu to change music, sound and vibration.

qa.q: Can I pause the game?
qa.a: Yes. There's a Pause button during play, and the pause screen has Settings, How to play and Points buttons.

qa.q: Why does my screen lock while I play?
qa.a: The app locks the screen while you play so the page doesn't scroll by accident. Tap Unlock on the pill to free the page.

qa.q: Who can win prizes?
qa.a: Employees and their households can play but can't win prizes. Everyone else who is eligible can.

qa.q: Do you send texts?
qa.a: Only if you choose. Texts about your rewards are sent for your account, and deal texts are optional. Reply STOP anytime to opt out.

qa.q: Is my information private?
qa.a: Your information is used only for your rewards account and is never sold. If you share your location, it stays on your phone.

qa.q: How do I get help from staff?
qa.a: Ask at the counter at either location. I don't have a phone number for StormBurger in the app.

qa.q: Can I leave a Google review?
qa.a: Yes. Use the Write a Google review button in the app. Honest reviews only, and no prizes are given for them.

qa.q: Where can I see StormBurger on Instagram?
qa.a: Follow @stormburger on Instagram. The app also shows their latest posts and reels.

qa.q: Do you have trivia or sports features?
qa.a: No. The app features the Storm Run game, the Daily Spin, rewards and the menu.
